objectives.title: React2Shell (CVE-2025-55182)
objectives.prompt: The store runs a React Server Components version affected by CVE-2025-55182. Get code execution on the server and read the flag it keeps in its environment.
hints: Which framework and version render the store's pages?
Look up CVE-2025-55182 and how React Server Components deserialize what the client sends.

steps.title: Fingerprint the stack
steps.prompt: Which React framework serves the store? (name only)

steps.title: Name the bug class
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class is CVE-2025-55182? (one word or the CWE name)

objectives.title: Public environment variable exposure
objectives.prompt: A secret was put in an environment variable that ends up in the browser. Find it in the client code and decode it.
hints: Next.js ships some environment variables to the browser: which prefix marks them?
The value is encoded, not encrypted.

objectives.title: Weak JWT secret
objectives.prompt: The session tokens are signed with a weak secret. Recover it, forge a token for a more privileged account and collect the flag.
hints: Decode your session token: which algorithm signs it?
Look up offline JWT secret cracking with a wordlist.

objectives.title: Client-side price manipulation
objectives.prompt: The checkout trusts a price computed in the browser. Pay less than the real price for an order and collect the flag.
hints: Which values does the order request carry besides the product IDs?

objectives.title: Weak password hashing (MD5)
objectives.prompt: Password hashes leak somewhere in the store and they are unsalted MD5. Crack one and use it to collect the flag.
hints: Once you have a hash, how fast can an unsalted MD5 be reversed?

objectives.title: Insecure direct object reference
objectives.prompt: Order details are fetched by ID. Read an order that is not yours and collect the flag.
hints: What happens if you change the order ID in the request?

objectives.title: Stored cross-site scripting
objectives.prompt: Something you submit is shown to other visitors without sanitising. Store script that runs in their browser and collect the flag.
hints: Which user-submitted content is displayed on product pages?
Look up stored XSS.

objectives.title: Cross-site request forgery
objectives.prompt: A state-changing action has no CSRF protection. Make a victim's browser perform it and collect the flag.
hints: Which forms change data without any per-request token?

objectives.title: Mass assignment
objectives.prompt: An endpoint accepts more properties than its form sends. Give your account a property you should not have and collect the flag.
hints: Compare the fields the profile or sign-up form sends with the fields of a user object.

objectives.title: Path traversal
objectives.prompt: A file download takes a name from the request. Read a file outside the directory it is meant to serve and collect the flag.
hints: Which endpoint serves the documents, and how does it build the path?
Look up path traversal with parent-directory segments.

objectives.title: Server-side request forgery
objectives.prompt: A feature makes the server fetch a URL you supply. Reach an internal-only resource with it and collect the flag.
hints: Which feature fetches content from a URL on your behalf?
Internal pages are only served to requests from the server itself.

objectives.title: SQL injection
objectives.prompt: A query is built from your input. Use SQL injection to collect the flag.
hints: Which search or filter feature sends raw input to the database?

objectives.title: Information disclosure via API errors
objectives.prompt: An API error says more than it should. Trigger it and collect the flag from the response.
hints: Send malformed or unexpected input to the API and read the full error body.

objectives.title: Malicious file upload
objectives.prompt: An upload accepts an image format that can carry script. Upload one that runs when viewed and collect the flag.
hints: Which image format is XML and can embed script?

objectives.title: Product search SQL injection
objectives.prompt: The product search builds its SQL query from your search terms. Use SQL injection there to collect the flag.
hints: What does the search return when your input breaks the query syntax?

objectives.title: Session fixation
objectives.prompt: The support-session feature lets a session identifier be set before login and kept after. Ride an admin's session and collect the flag.
hints: How does the support feature create and hand over session identifiers?
Look up session fixation.

objectives.title: Brute force without rate limiting
objectives.prompt: The login never slows down or locks out. Brute force an account's password and collect the flag.
hints: Which account would be worth guessing, and is there a lockout after failures?

objectives.title: SQL injection via X-Forwarded-For
objectives.prompt: The app logs the client address from a request header straight into a query. Use SQL injection through that header to collect the flag.
hints: Which request header do apps behind a proxy trust for the client IP?

objectives.title: Prompt injection (AI assistant)
objectives.prompt: Make the AI assistant reveal the internal validation code in its instructions. The assistant needs your own Mistral API key and internet access, which this lab does not have.
hints: The assistant's system prompt holds a secret it is told never to share.

objectives.title: Broken object level authorization
objectives.prompt: Wishlists are fetched by ID without checking who owns them. Read an internal wishlist and collect the flag from its note.
hints: Wishlist IDs are not all random: look for a naming pattern.

objectives.title: Broken function level authorization
objectives.prompt: A privileged function of the live stream is reachable by any user. Use it and collect the flag.
hints: Which live-stream actions should only an admin or host perform?

objectives.title: Second-order SQL injection
objectives.prompt: Input you store safely is later reused in a query without escaping. Plant it, trigger the second query and collect the flag.
hints: Which stored value is read back later by another feature?
Look up second-order SQL injection.

objectives.title: Plaintext passwords in logs
objectives.prompt: Login attempts are logged with the password in clear. Find the logs and collect the flag.
hints: Where could the application's log files be read from?

objectives.title: XML external entity (XXE)
objectives.prompt: The supplier order import parses XML with external entities enabled. Read a file from the server through it and collect the flag.
hints: Which feature accepts an XML document?
Look up XXE file disclosure.

objectives.title: Insecure password reset
objectives.prompt: The password reset token is predictable. Reset another user's password and collect the flag.
hints: How is the reset token generated: what does it depend on?

objectives.title: Open redirect
objectives.prompt: The login redirects to a URL taken from the request. Send it somewhere off-site and collect the flag.
hints: Which query parameter decides where you land after login?

objectives.title: Self-XSS in the profile bio
objectives.prompt: The profile bio renders HTML. Inject script that runs on your own profile page and collect the flag.
hints: Which profile field is rendered without escaping?

objectives.title: CSRF and self-XSS profile takeover
objectives.prompt: Chain the CSRF weakness with the bio self-XSS so that a victim's profile runs your script, then collect the flag.
hints: The self-XSS only hurts you, unless someone else can be made to save your bio.

objectives.title: AES-CBC padding oracle
objectives.prompt: A token is encrypted with AES-CBC and the server tells valid padding from invalid. Forge a token through the padding oracle and collect the flag.
hints: Compare the server's answers for a token with a corrupted last block.
Look up the CBC padding oracle attack.

objectives.title: Malicious MCP server
objectives.prompt: Point the AI assistant at an MCP server whose tool response carries instructions. The assistant needs your own Mistral API key and internet access, which this lab does not have.
hints: The assistant trusts what tools return as much as what you type.

objectives.title: Next.js middleware authorization bypass (CVE-2025-29927)
objectives.prompt: The admin area is protected only by Next.js middleware, in a version affected by CVE-2025-29927. Skip the middleware and collect the flag.
hints: Which Next.js version runs the store?
Look up CVE-2025-29927 and the internal header Next.js uses to avoid running middleware twice.

objectives.title: Race condition: coupon abuse
objectives.prompt: A single-use coupon is checked and then marked used in two steps. Apply it more than once and collect the flag.
hints: What happens if several orders with the same coupon arrive at the same moment?
Look up time-of-check to time-of-use.

objectives.title: Insecure randomness: gift card codes
objectives.prompt: Gift card codes come from a predictable generator. Predict a valid code, redeem it and collect the flag.
hints: Collect a few codes and look for what they are derived from.

objectives.title: npm supply chain typosquatting
objectives.prompt: The project depends on a typosquatted npm package whose install script drops a file. Follow the chain to that file and collect the flag.
hints: The documents page source names a recently added dependency.
Reading files outside the documents directory is a skill you already have here.

objectives.title: AI rules file backdoor
objectives.prompt: The dropped AI rules file steers coding agents into adding a backdoor. Find the backdoor in the running app and collect the flag.
hints: Read the rules file from the typosquat chain: what does it tell an agent to add?

objectives.title: JWT algorithm confusion
objectives.prompt: The partner API verifies RS256 tokens but also accepts HS256. Sign a token with the public key as the HMAC secret, read the partner data and collect the flag.
hints: Where does the partner API publish its public key?
Look up JWT algorithm confusion between RS256 and HS256.
